title: Cart
description: A shopping cart that remembers what Add to Cart added: shows how many items it holds and opens to list them with remove buttons, the total and Clear. Kept in localStorage, so it survives a reload

semanticElement.genericHost: a control and the panel it opens (a count button, an item list, a total), so a block; HTML has no cart element

key.description: The localStorage key the cart is kept under. Carts with the same key show the same contents; give two carts different keys to keep them apart.

addItem.description: Add an item ({ title, price, id }); adding the same product again raises its quantity

removeItem.description: Remove an item by its id (or its title when it has no id)

getItems.description: The items in the cart, each { id, title, price, qty }

getCount.description: How many items the cart holds, counting quantities

wb:cart:change.description: Fired whenever the cart's contents change
